config.model: periodic H=-sum ZZ_nn+kappa sum ZZ_nnn-h sum X; wire0 MSB
config.circuit: unchanged prepare(): H all; NN ZZ, NNN ZZ, RX; gamma/eta/beta per layer
config.compilation: literal CNOT-RZ-CNOT with target channel after each CNOT; no cancellation including zero angles; NN/NNN directly connected
config.branch_check_selection: Before noise: among chosen chain-switch positions, rank opposite-direction pure-state infidelity descending, select at most 12 positions; no tuning on noise

diagnostics.difference: numpy.gradient edge_order=2 on contiguous valid segments length>=3
diagnostics.peak_stability: full and every-other-node grid same-feature peak within 0.1 in h; both alternating subsamples checked
diagnostics.peak_matching: unique mutual-nearest same observable, max displacement 0.2; overlap of cross-indicator shifts required for claimed displacement
diagnostics.failure_policy: Do not differentiate across preparation failure; retain raw records and not_resolved
diagnostics.peak_width: half-prominence width in h; not statistical uncertainty

grid.selection: Among qualifying L4/L6 maximize selected joint coverage, then minimize CNOT; no noise-based selection
grid.optimization: Reuse exact matching slice selections; other rows use ascending/descending chains, seeds 101,211,307, 2000 iterations, energy-only selection; no threshold relaxation

config.density_backend: stage3 NumPy full density, literal gate/channel actions; adopt only after full-array cross-check versus PennyLane default.mixed; no symmetry reduction or output projection
config.cache: fingerprint includes model,circuit/compile source,optimizer config,full initial/final parameter hash,p,wire basis,backend versions
config.p0_density: execute identical full-density schedule, including identity channels
